title: Grateful Dead Live at P.N.E. Coliseum on 1973-06-22
lineage: composite: MSR> PCM> DAT> CD> EAC> WAV> SHN; MAC> R> R> CD> DAT> WAV> SHN; MSR> C> DAT> CD> EAC> WAV> SHN

ai_review.summary: A superb matrix capture of a 1973 masterpiece with crystal‑clear mix, soaring Bird Song, epic Playing in the Band and marathon jams.
ai_review.review: The recording is an expertly balanced matrix of soundboard and audience sources – crisp, well‑separated and only marred by a few early‑set splices. Musically the show is consistently praised as one of the year’s highlights, featuring a transcendent Bird Song, a monster Playing in the Band, long Truckin’/Nobody’s Jam passages, a mellow Other One and standout performances from every member.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating ~4.6/5 across 27 reviews, with unanimous praise for both performance and sound; minor technical issues do not detract from overall excellence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mostly crystal‑clear mix with beautiful separation of instruments. Early discs have some volume drops and splice artifacts, but audience patches fill holes and the later discs sound pristine.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > Uncle John's Band jam
show_quality.setlist_flow: Relaxed, loose first set that builds into a high‑energy second set; the show peaks after Bird Song and maintains momentum with long, inventive jams and tight transitions.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Gentle, humble tone with creative riffs; praised for his melodic ideas throughout the marathon jams.
band_member_comments.Phil: Highly creative bass work, often described as a third guitar; noted for an especially long solo and beautiful harmonies.
band_member_comments.Bob: Highlighted for taking lead on China Cat Sunflower and delivering solid rhythm/vocal support.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's organ is prominent and beautifully mixed, adding depth to verses and jams.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann and Mickey Hart receive general commendations for tight, driving rhythms that propel the long improvisations.
